require 'net/http'
require 'uri'
require 'base64'
require 'digest'
require 'securerandom'
require 'json'
require 'logger'

module AuthProxy
  class CircuitBreaker
    STATES = [:closed, :open, :half_open].freeze
    
    attr_reader :state, :failure_count, :last_failure_time
    
    def initialize(threshold: 5, timeout: 30, logger: Logger.new(STDOUT))
      @threshold = threshold
      @timeout = timeout
      @state = :closed
      @failure_count = 0
      @last_failure_time = nil
      @mutex = Mutex.new
      @logger = logger
    end
    
    def call(&block)
      case @state
      when :open
        if Time.now - @last_failure_time >= @timeout
          try_half_open(&block)
        else
          raise CircuitOpenError, "Circuit breaker is open"
        end
      when :half_open
        try_half_open(&block)
      when :closed
        try_request(&block)
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def try_half_open(&block)
      @mutex.synchronize { @state = :half_open }
      result = block.call
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @state = :closed
        @failure_count = 0
      end
      result
    rescue => e
      record_failure
      raise
    end
    
    def try_request(&block)
      result = block.call
      result
    rescue => e
      record_failure
      raise
    end
    
    def record_failure
      @mutex.synchronize do
        @failure_count += 1
        @last_failure_time = Time.now
        if @failure_count >= @threshold
          @state = :open
          @logger.warn("Circuit breaker opened after #{@failure_count} failures")
        end
      end
    end
  end
  
  class CircuitOpenError < StandardError; end
  
  class NtlmAuthenticator
    NTLM_SIGNATURE = "NTLMSSP\x00"
    
    def initialize(domain:, backend_url:, circuit_breaker:)
      @domain = domain
      @backend_url = backend_url
      @circuit_breaker = circuit_breaker
      @session_store = {}
      @logger = Logger.new(STDOUT)
      @channel_binding_secret = SecureRandom.hex(32)
    end
    
    def authenticate(request_env)
      auth_header = request_env['HTTP_AUTHORIZATION']
      return challenge_response unless auth_header
      
      scheme, token = auth_header.split(' ', 2)
      return challenge_response unless scheme&.downcase == 'ntlm'
      
      ntlm_message = Base64.decode64(token)
      msg_type = extract_message_type(ntlm_message)
      
      case msg_type
      when 1
        handle_type1(ntlm_message, request_env)
      when 3
        handle_type3(ntlm_message, request_env)
      else
        [401, {'WWW-Authenticate' => 'NTLM'}, ['Invalid NTLM message']]
      end
    end
    
    private
    
    def extract_message_type(message)
      return nil unless message.start_with?(NTLM_SIGNATURE)
      message[8..11].unpack1('V')
    end
    
    def handle_type1(negotiate_msg, request_env)
      session_id = SecureRandom.hex(16)
      client_ip = request_env['REMOTE_ADDR']
      
      challenge = generate_challenge_locally(session_id, client_ip)
      
      if challenge
        request_env['rack.session'] ||= {}
        request_env['rack.session'][:ntlm_session] = session_id
        encoded = Base64.strict_encode64(challenge)
        [401, {'WWW-Authenticate' => "NTLM #{encoded}"}, ['']]
      else
        challenge_response
      end
    end
    
    def handle_type3(auth_msg, request_env)
      session_id = request_env.dig('rack.session', :ntlm_session)
      return challenge_response unless session_id
      
      session_data = @session_store[session_id]
      return challenge_response unless session_data
      
      # Verify channel binding - ties auth to this specific connection
      client_ip = request_env['REMOTE_ADDR']
      expected_binding = compute_channel_binding(session_id, client_ip)
      return challenge_response unless session_data[:channel_binding] == expected_binding
      
      # Verify session hasn't expired (30 second window)
      return challenge_response if Time.now - session_data[:timestamp] > 30
      
      result = validate_locally(auth_msg, session_data)
      @session_store.delete(session_id)
      
      if result[:authenticated]
        request_env['rack.session'].delete(:ntlm_session)
        [200, {'Content-Type' => 'application/json'}, 
         [JSON.generate({user: result[:username], domain: @domain})]]
      else
        challenge_response
      end
    end
    
    def generate_challenge_locally(session_id, client_ip)
      server_challenge = SecureRandom.random_bytes(8)
      channel_binding = compute_channel_binding(session_id, client_ip)
      
      @session_store[session_id] = {
        challenge: server_challenge,
        channel_binding: channel_binding,
        timestamp: Time.now
      }
      
      build_type2_message(server_challenge)
    end
    
    def compute_channel_binding(session_id, client_ip)
      Digest::SHA256.hexdigest("#{@channel_binding_secret}:#{session_id}:#{client_ip}")
    end
    
    def build_type2_message(challenge)
      msg = NTLM_SIGNATURE.dup
      msg << [2].pack('V')           # Type 2
      msg << [0, 0, 56].pack('vvV')  # Target name (empty)
      msg << [0x00028233].pack('V')  # Flags
      msg << challenge               # Server challenge
      msg << "\x00" * 8             # Reserved
      msg << [0, 0, 56].pack('vvV')  # Target info (empty)
      msg
    end
    
    def validate_locally(auth_msg, session_data)
      # In production, validate NTLMv2 response against local credential store
      # This validates the cryptographic response against the stored challenge
      username = extract_username(auth_msg)
      
      # Verify the NTLM response was computed with our challenge
      # (simplified - production would verify NTProofStr)
      if username && username != 'unknown'
        @circuit_breaker.call do
          verify_credentials_against_dc(username, auth_msg, session_data[:challenge])
        end
      else
        {authenticated: false}
      end
    rescue CircuitOpenError => e
      @logger.error("DC unavailable: #{e.message}")
      {authenticated: false}
    end
    
    def verify_credentials_against_dc(username, auth_msg, challenge)
      uri = URI.parse("#{@backend_url}/ntlm/verify")
      http = Net::HTTP.new(uri.host, uri.port)
      http.use_ssl = uri.scheme == 'https'
      http.verify_mode = OpenSSL::SSL::VERIFY_PEER if http.use_ssl?
      http.open_timeout = 5
      http.read_timeout = 5
      
      request = Net::HTTP::Post.new(uri.path)
      request['Content-Type'] = 'application/json'
      request.body = JSON.generate({
        username: username,
        nt_response: Base64.strict_encode64(auth_msg),
        server_challenge: Base64.strict_encode64(challenge)
      })
      
      response = http.request(request)
      
      if response.code == '200'
        {authenticated: true, username: username}
      else
        {authenticated: false}
      end
    end
    
    def extract_username(type3_msg)
      return 'unknown' unless type3_msg.length > 36
      domain_len = type3_msg[28..29].unpack1('v')
      domain_offset = type3_msg[32..35].unpack1('V')
      user_len = type3_msg[36..37].unpack1('v')
      user_offset = type3_msg[40..43].unpack1('V')
      
      if user_offset && user_len && user_offset + user_len <= type3_msg.length
        type3_msg[user_offset, user_len].force_encoding('UTF-16LE').encode('UTF-8') rescue 'unknown'
      else
        'unknown'
      end
    end
    
    def challenge_response
      [401, {'WWW-Authenticate' => 'NTLM'}, ['Authentication required']]
    end
  end
  
  class Middleware
    def initialize(app, domain:, backend_url:)
      @app = app
      @circuit_breaker = CircuitBreaker.new(threshold: 3, timeout: 60)
      @authenticator = NtlmAuthenticator.new(
        domain: domain,
        backend_url: backend_url,
        circuit_breaker: @circuit_breaker
      )
    end
    
    def call(env)
      if requires_auth?(env)
        result = @authenticator.authenticate(env)
        return result unless result[0] == 200
        env['REMOTE_USER'] = JSON.parse(result[2].first)['user']
      end
      @app.call(env)
    end
    
    private
    
    def requires_auth?(env)
      !env['PATH_INFO'].start_with?('/health', '/public')
    end
  end
end
